eidolons.name: Memory of You
eidolons.desc: Every time March 7th's Ultimate Freezes a target, she regenerates 6 Energy.

eidolons.name: Memory of It
eidolons.desc: Upon entering battle, grants a Shield equal to 24% of March 7th's DEF plus 320 to the ally with the lowest HP percentage, lasting for 3 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Memory of Everything
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Never Forfeit Again
eidolons.desc: The Talent's Counter effect can be triggered 1 more time in each turn. The DMG dealt by Counter increases by an amount that is equal to 30% of March 7th's DEF.

eidolons.name: Never Forget Again
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Just Like This, Always...
eidolons.desc: Allies under the protection of the Shield granted by the Skill restore HP equal to 4% of their Max HP plus 106 at the beginning of each turn.

basic.name: Frigid Cold Arrow
basic.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to {0}% of March 7th's ATK to one enemy.

skill.name: The Power of Cuteness
skill.desc:
Provides a single ally with a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to {0}% of March 7th's DEF plus {1} for 3 turn(s).
If the ally's current HP percentage is 30% or higher, greatly increases the chance of enemies attacking that ally.

ult.name: Glacial Cascade
ult.desc:
Deals Ice DMG equal to {0}% of March 7th's ATK to all enemies. Hit enemies have a 50% base chance to be Frozen for 1 turn(s).
While Frozen, enemies cannot take action and will receive Ice Additional DMG equal to {1}% of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

talent.name: Girl Power
talent.desc: After a Shielded ally is attacked by an enemy, March 7th immediately Counters, dealing Ice DMG equal to {0}% of her ATK. This effect can be triggered 2 time(s) each turn.

technique.name: Freezing Beauty
technique.desc:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, there is a 100% base chance to Freeze a random enemy for 1 turn(s).
While Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice Additional DMG equal to 50% of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

ability_1.name: Purify
ability_1.desc: When using Skill, dispels 1 debuff from one designated ally.

ability_2.name: Reinforce
ability_2.desc: The duration of the Shield generated from Skill is extended for 1 turn(s).

ability_3.name: Ice Spell
ability_3.desc: When using Ultimate, increases the base chance to Freeze enemies by 15%.

lightCones.name: Moment of Victory
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's DEF by 24% and Effect Hit Rate by 24%. Increases the chance for the wearer to be attacked by enemies. When the wearer is attacked, increase their DEF by an extra 24% until the end of the wearer's turn.

lightCones.name: Day One of My New Life
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's DEF by 16%. After entering battle, increases All-Type RES of all allies by 8%. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

lightCones.name: This Is Me!
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's DEF by 16%. Increases the DMG of the wearer when they use their Ultimate by 60% of the wearer's DEF. This effect only applies 1 time per enemy target during each use of the wearer's Ultimate.

lightCones.name: Trend of the Universal Market
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's DEF by 16%. When the wearer is attacked, there is a 100% base chance to Burn the enemy. For each turn, the wearer deals DoT that is equal to 40% of the wearer's DEF for 2 turn(s).

relicSets.name: Self-Enshrouded Recluse
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases Shield Effect by 10%. 4-pc: Increases Shield Effect provided by the wearer by 12%. When an ally target has a Shield provided by the wearer, their CRIT DMG increases by 15%.

planarSets.name: Belobog of the Architects
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's DEF by 15%. When the wearer's Effect Hit Rate is 50% or higher, the wearer gains an extra 15% DEF.

planarSets.name: Broken Keel
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by 10%. When the wearer's Effect RES is at 30% or higher, all allies' CRIT DMG increases by 10%.

lore.description:
A spirited and quirky young girl who is into all the things girls her age are interested in, such as taking photos.
She was awakened from a piece of drifting eternal ice, only to find that she knows nothing about herself or her past. Though initially feeling dejected, she decided to name herself after the date of her rebirth.
And thus, on that day, March 7th was born.
stories: Why does March 7th take photos? "First of all, girls like me should like this kind of pastime." "Besides, I won't forget anything that I keep a photo of." What has March 7th come to learn about photography? "Number one, when taking pictures of terrible cuisines, all the details must be clearly visible on the pictures because 'Taking pictures of food is equal to eating them. Every detail matters.'" "Number two, as long as you take a picture with your eyes closed, you will be able to capture an expression of your subject with their eyes closed." Why is March 7th always wearing her camera? "Because if anyone ever seals me away in ice again, at least I'll have my camera with me!" So why doesn't March 7th just use the camera on her phone? "Oh yeah, why not — hang on, it's because of that sense of formality!"

March 7th's ability is "Six-Phased Ice," but she has always insisted that it is not ice but some kind of condensed crystal. "Come on, ice can't be this beautiful." The bows and arrows March 7th uses in battle are also made of the Six-Phased Ice, but she is not satisfied with the fact that her weapon is a bow. "Great warriors never use bows!" "Besides, if I use my ice arrow to attack my ice shield, nothing will happen at all!" March 7th has also worked hard to practice a unique skill called "Starshatter: Shard Supreme," but she never succeeded. "March, judging by the name, it should be a greatsword, right?" "Well, but it feels like it may not even be as good as an ice sculpture... Ugh."

Compared to Pom-Pom the conductor, Himeko the Navigator, Dan Heng the Guard, and Welt the Jack-of-all-Trades, even March 7th has a hard time explaining her role aboard the Express despite calling herself a "Warrior." But March 7th's every move affects the crew's course of action all the time. "Passenger March 7th slipped and fell..." "March, watch out for the galena ball above your head." "March, have you taken pictures of the sights over there?" "I believe March. If she said it's not delicious, then it's truly not delectable." Rather than calling March 7th someone who constantly worries people, it would be better to say that she works her way into people's hearts. March 7th, of course, is oblivious to this, and is struggling to think up the right role for Trailblazer.

For March 7th, who has been drifting in space, the situation in which she awoke isn't too bad. She woke up on a passing train, and the people on the train looked friendly. The only problem is that even though she has a reasonable understanding of what's going on around her, she still doesn't know anything about herself. "Who am I? Where do I come from..." March 7th looks at herself in the mirror, imagining dozens of potential past lives for herself as she tries on the various outfits that Himeko had assembled for her. But she can't be sure what her past was like, and what kind of past a girl like her should have... The only thing March 7th can choose to be is her current self, and the only thing she can look forward to is the future. She is both frightened and glad.
